title.narrative: Bangladesh: Disability Inclusive Vocational Training and Youth Employment

description.narrative: Through this Task Order (TO), the proven and tested disability inclusion approach of BRAC’s ‘Skills Training for Advancing Resources’ (STAR) programme will be scaled across all seven divisions of Bangladesh by: a) a numerical and proportional increase in participating youth with disability; b) diversification of the impairment groups served; c) adaptation of the STAR approach by partners and; d) advocacy for adoption of the approach by other mainstream skills providers. This will lead to improved access to decent employment and increased income for young women and men with disabilities in Bangladesh, making a significant contribution to the DID programme’s overall objectives and specific results.
